name: CMS Energy
description: CMS Energy is the holding company for Consumers Energy, a combined electric and gas utility serving 1.9 million electric and 1.8 million gas customers in Michigan's Lower Peninsula (6.8 million of the state's 10 million residents). Consumers is regulated by the Michigan Public Service Commission, which sets rates to recover costs plus an authorised return (9.90% on equity for electric and 9.80% for gas in the latest orders). A small non-utility unit, NorthStar Clean Energy, owns independent power generation and markets power. About 66% of 2025 revenue is electric, 29% gas and 5% NorthStar, and profit grows mainly as Consumers invests in the grid, generation and gas system and wins rate increases.

That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Full-time and part-time employees of CMS Energy including Consumers (8,324 in 2024); Consumers alone 8,095 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Electric utility (Consumers)
businessLines.how: Customers pay MPSC-approved electric rates monthly; the utility recovers costs and earns an allowed return on the capital invested in generation, wires and renewables, and it passes fuel and purchased-power costs through; Michigan also lets up to 10% of sales go to alternative suppliers (ROA).
businessLines.description: Generation, purchase, distribution and sale of electricity to 1.9 million customers in Michigan's Lower Peninsula (residential, commercial and diversified industrial); about 32% of electric supply is bought through long-term power-purchase agreements and the MISO market.

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to common stockholders (segment profit measure); FY2024 $681M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/811156/000081115626000004/cms-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Gas utility (Consumers)
businessLines.how: Customers pay MPSC-approved gas delivery rates monthly; the utility earns an allowed return on its pipes and storage and passes through the cost of gas.
businessLines.description: Purchase, transmission, storage, distribution and sale of natural gas to 1.8 million customers in Michigan's Lower Peninsula.

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to common stockholders; FY2024 $328M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/811156/000081115626000004/cms-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: NorthStar Clean Energy
businessLines.how: Sells power from its renewable and other generating projects, mostly under contract, and earns marketing margins from selling independent producers' output; unregulated, so earnings depend on contract prices and project performance.
businessLines.description: Domestic independent power production (renewable generation development and operation, equity investments) and marketing of independent power production (CMS Energy Resource Management Company).

operatingProfit.note: Net income available to common stockholders; FY2024 $63M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/811156/000081115626000004/cms-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Corporate interest and other
businessLines.how: Not an operating business: holding-company debt cost that Consumers' earnings must cover.

brands.name: Consumers Energy
brands.note: Consumers' consolidated operating revenue was $8.1B of CMS Energy's $8.5B in 2025 (95%); 1.9 million electric and 1.8 million gas customers

brands.name: NorthStar Clean Energy
brands.note: $408M of revenue (4.8%); includes CMS Energy Resource Management Company
